'''Leequa''' was a location on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]].<ref name="WAY" /> In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="208Date">{{AndorDate|208}}</ref> an [[fleet|armada]] affiliated with the [[Galactic Empire]] began unloading [[Mining rig|mining equipment]] in Leequa<ref name="WAY" /> to provoke an [[Ghorman Massacre|uprising]] against the Empire as pretext for its crackdown on the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] and [[Gouge mining|mining]] of Ghorman's [[kalkite]] deposits.<ref name="OYL">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> As part of [[Project Celestial Power]],<ref name="Catalyst">''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''</ref> the Empire needed the [[mineral]] for the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[Hypermatter reactor|hypermatter annihilation reactor's]] lens coating.<ref name="OYL" />

When protests broke out in Ghorman's [[capital]] [[city]] [[Palmo]] the next [[Local day|day]], [[Imperial Bureau of Standards]] employee [[Syril Karn]] mentioned the presence of Imperial mining ships in Leequa and [[Jel-Novi]] to [[ISB Supervisor]] [[Dedra Meero]] when he confronted her on the true purpose of the Imperial presence on Ghorman.<ref name="WAY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Leequa was mentioned in "[[Who Are You?]],"<ref name="WAY" /> the eighth episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|233|Andor Season 2 Companion|''Andor'' Season 2 Companion}}</ref>
